name: Maimonides
biography: Spanish-Jewish philosopher (b. Cordova 1135, d. Cairo), author of 'Guide to Wanderers,' which sought to reconcile Aristotle with Jewish theology, holding that philosophy and revelation converge in the knowledge of God and that Scripture should be read allegorically where it conflicts with reason.
